As one of the hubs for KPop Demon Hunters merch, we’re seeing everything from official brand collaborations, including Squishmallows , to household essentials, apparel, framed artwork, jewelry and Halloween costume accessories. The timing of Amazon Prime Big Deal Days is also ideal for fans shopping for Halloween costumes or getting a head start on holiday gifts.

At a Glance: KPop Demon Hunters Merch Sales During October Prime Day

- Dates: Oct. 6-7, 2026

- Get Prime: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days is exclusive to Prime members. New members can avail of these discounts by signing up for a 30-day free trial .

Get Amazon Prime to Enjoy Prime Big Deal Days 2026

Prime Big Deal Days is a Prime member -only event, so you’ll need an Amazon Prime membership to access the savings on Oct. 6-7. A membership costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year, but new members can start with a 30-day free trial that includes Prime’s standard benefits. That means you can shop member-exclusive deals while also getting perks such as fast delivery, Prime Video, Prime Reading and Music, Amazon Photos storage and select grocery and delivery benefits. After the trial ends, the membership automatically renews unless you cancel. Prime for Young Adults is available for $7.49 per month for eligible members.
